_about: The two Primal (2019) S03 releases a Discord user's zurg held, ten episodes each, as zurg's own feed code (internal/rexfeed managerLibrary.Items, zurg main c024abc0) builds their items, run by a throwaway generator that was not committed. `episode` is DMM's placement of both releases on 2026-11-04 (/api/sponsor/place, asked with tt7394816 or no id): kind tv, IMDb tt10332508, TMDB 89456, each file season 3 episode n by TMDB; only S03E01's tmdbEpisodeId (6652661) was recorded, so the others go without. `film` is the same files placed as a film, which DMM once answered (the 2019 film tt7394816): Plex's agent answers for that film were not recorded, so the film is a stand-in, 127 Hours (tt1542344, TMDB 44115), whose answer duplicate_releases.json holds; a film's rows fold into versions only once Plex's agent names them. The torrents fed to the generator are the recorded file names and release names with duplicate_releases.json's two releases' hash, size and probe (the AC3 release entry 0's, the DTS-HD one entry 1's); each item's `media_info` is left out here and is that entry's, the probe `probe` digests. Those probes run 94 minutes, so today's zurg still sends the film placement as a film; with Primal's own 22-minute probes it sends it unplaced (episodeRun), as the zurg that made the user's rows did not. The user's own rex.db was not available.
